set.body: Add JVM-only GIFTI surface reader for POINTSET/TRIANGLE arrays and surface-to-world affine extraction. Acceptance: parser preserves 0-based triangle indices internally, extracts a 4x4 CoordinateSystemTransformMatrix when present, uses identity when absent, rejects malformed point/triangle arrays, and has small fixture tests. Likely paths: modules/surface/jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/io, modules/surface/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface/io, modules/surface/jvm/src/test/resources.
set.title: JVM GIFTI surface geometry IO and affine extraction
